subject: S08->S10: predicate and mounts (already landed)
body: 1) Gate: migration 0010 flashcards_read_authenticated = owner_user_id=auth.uid() OR (owner_user_id is null AND (question_id is null OR public.qbank_has_graded_attempt(question_id))); the function = exists attempt for auth.uid(), that question, chosen not null and correct not null. No mode/block condition. Mock questions are never in tutor blocks, so no attempts exist for them via the API. 2) Your CardsDueLink and SaveAsFlashcard are mounted in BuilderPage/QuestionPage already. For the aborted /api/cards/stats console error: the browser logs a cancelled fetch regardless of AbortController; I made the qbank e2e wait for network idle before navigating. Nothing needed in your hook.
